The '''Bovris Tapcafe''' was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ifron/Legends|Ifron]]; it had a reputation as a seedy dive. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] visited the establishment during her search for [[Dequc]].
